title: "03 · Centrality and communities"
execute:

---

Four centralities on the same graph, and the interesting figure is where they
disagree. On Zachary's karate club, eigenvector and betweenness correlate at
0.694, the weakest pair in the set; closeness spans a factor of two where degree
spans seventeen.

The community half is judged, not just displayed. Against the faction split
Zachary recorded, only one of the three detected groups is pure and two members
land on the wrong side; seven backends give partitions of 3, 5, 7, 12, 17 and 19
groups, ranked differently by modularity and by surprise. Three of the interface
controls do not work: the resolution parameter never reaches the detection, the
seed is accepted and unused, and the default backend does not return at all on a
thirty-four-node graph.
